plan: PLAN.md Phase 3 (serving: label, probabilities, OOD score and an abstain flag with a threshold chosen on validation) and the risk-coverage item moved to Phase 3 from Phase 2
serving_hardware: CPU (owner's decision: PyTorch on CPU). Every score here is computed on Databricks serverless CPU; Phase 2 showed GPU and CPU detector scores differ, so nothing GPU-computed is reused
model: the shipped EfficientNet-B0 v2 ensemble: seeds 0 to 2, each checkpoint checked by weight hash; class probabilities are the mean of the three softmax outputs

ood_score.detector: Mahalanobis per seed (cdm.ood.MahalanobisDetector), PCA sized by Phase 2's method D (95% of training-feature variance), fit on that seed's CPU features of the clients' training split only
ood_score.ensemble_score: the mean of the three seeds' Mahalanobis scores; higher is more out-of-distribution

abstain_threshold.rule: the 95th percentile of the ensemble OOD score on the clients' validation split, so 5% of in-distribution images are sent to review by construction

refer_flag: the Phase 2 triage threshold, melanoma probability >= 0.0638 (results/phase2/triage/threshold.json), returned as a separate flag; it is not re-chosen here

orders.confidence: abstain on the images with the lowest top class probability first
orders.ood: abstain on the images with the highest ensemble OOD score first

risk_coverage.metrics: accuracy and balanced accuracy (over the classes present) on the kept images, for each order and coverage
risk_coverage.workload: the share of images whose OOD score is above the abstain threshold (sent to review), per set
risk_coverage.sets: validation first (it sets the threshold); then one look at the clients' test split, per client, and the labelled images of Buenos Aires and PAD-UFES-20

test_look: the test and external-site part runs once: an attempt log is written before any test image is scored, results are saved before the lock, and the job refuses if a results file or lock exists

bundle.what: per seed: the checkpoint's hash and the detector's arrays (PCA mean and components, class means, precision matrix); the abstain threshold; the refer threshold; the class list; a manifest with SHA-256 of every file

check: the serving code's NumPy scorer (cdm.serving) must reproduce MahalanobisDetector.score on the validation features to within 1e-6 relative, or the bundle is not written
